requirements.label: GE distribution
requirements.text: Complete one of the following: (Note: A higher level MATH course may substitute for this requirement)

requirements.label: 3 credits of any other GE distribution course

ART 1120.title: 2D Design
ART 1120.prereqText: Major in Art and Design or Entertainment Design or Art Education or Digital Media

ART 2220.title: Imagination and Visual Literacy
ART 2220.prereqText: Formal acceptance to Associate of Applied Science in Illustration or Entertainment Design (AAS) Program by portfolio review

ART 2240.title: Illustrative Media and Techniques II
ART 2240.prereqText: Formal acceptance to Associate of Applied Science in Illustration or Entertainment Design (AAS) Program by portfolio review

ART 2250.title: Gestural Drawing
ART 2250.prereqText: Formal acceptance to Associate of Applied Science in Illustration or Entertainment Design (AAS) Program by portfolio review.

ART 2260.title: Digital Painting I
ART 2260.prereqText: ART 1400 , Formal acceptance to Associate of Applied Science in Illustration or Entertainment Design (AAS) Program by portfolio review.

ART 2270.title: Figure Drawing I
ART 2270.prereqText: Formal acceptance to Associate of Applied Science in Illustration or Entertainment Design (AAS) Program by portfolio review.

ART 2280.title: 3D Modeling
ART 2280.prereqText: ART 1400 , Declared Graphic Design (AAS), or formal acceptance to AAS in Entertainment Design or Illustration Program by portfolio review.

ART 2440.title: Motion Graphics I
ART 2440.prereqText: ART 1110 or ART 1210 , ART 1120 , ART 1400 , declared Entertainment Design (AAS), or formal acceptance to Associate of Applied Science in Graphic Design (AAS) Program by portfolio review, or department approval

ENGL 1010.title: Introduction to Academic Writing
ENGL 1010.prereqText: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years.

ENGL 2010.title: Intermediate Academic Writing
ENGL 2010.prereqText: Appropriate ACT test scores taken within the last three years or completion of ENGL 1010 or ENGL 1010H or ENGL 1005 with a grade of C- or higher.

MAT 1030.title: Quantitative Reasoning
MAT 1030.prereqText: One of the following (within department time limits): MAT 1020 (preferred), or MAT1015 or MAT 1010 with a grade of C– or higher; or appropriate placement by a placement exam.

MAT 1035.title: Quantitative Reasoning with Integrated Algebra
MAT 1035.prereqText: One of the following (within department time limits): MAT 0950 with a grade of C- or higher, or MAT 0980 with a grade of C- or higher, or appropriate placement by a placement exam.
